notes: This app (test_app_v6_r4) is a copy of test_app_v6 ported to Ruby 4.0.7 specifically for this comparison -- it did not previously exist. Required real Gemfile fixes to boot at all: activesupport 6.1.7.10 requires bigdecimal and mutex_m at boot without declaring them as dependencies (hard LoadError on Ruby 4.0.7, not just a warning as under 3.3.12); sass-rails/sassc-rails likewise require 'benchmark', removed as a default gem in Ruby 4.0.0. All three added directly to the Gemfile. No other compatibility issues surfaced -- bundle install, db:migrate, the full RSpec suite (21 examples), and a from-scratch production assets:precompile (Webpacker, with the same NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider workaround as test_app_v6) all succeeded cleanly once those three gems were added.

Spring works normally under Ruby 4.0.7 once boot succeeds, but all measurements below use DISABLE_SPRING=1 (boot_time_seconds, test_suite) or RAILS_ENV=production (http, puma_rss, ar_validation microbench -- Spring never preloads a production-mode app on this system, confirmed during test_app_v6's own benchmark) to avoid any Spring-warm-process confound, matching test_app_v6's methodology exactly.

HTTP load test: ab -n 500 -c 10 against /bicycles and /bicycles/1, RAILS_ENV=production with precompiled assets, DATABASE_URL override pointing at a local dedicated test_app_v6_r4_production database (own Postgres role/password in database.yml never provisioned locally, same pattern as test_app_v6 and test_app_v7_to_v8_org_v6_r3). 0 failed requests on both endpoints. Own isolated Postgres databases (test_app_v6_r4_*), no shared state with test_app_v6.
boot_time_seconds/boot_rss_mb measured via `/usr/bin/time -l bin/rails runner "exit"` in RAILS_ENV=production, 5 samples.
test_suite duration is bundle exec rspec's own reported 'Finished in' wall time (test env), 3 samples.

microbench_ips computed with the identical scripts used for v6/v8 (iterations / Benchmark.realtime): ar_validation 50k Bicycle#valid? calls under RAILS_ENV=production via bin/rails runner; json_roundtrip 500k JSON.generate+JSON.parse roundtrips; array_sort 1k iterations of building+sorting a 10k-element random Integer array -- plain `ruby` (Ruby 4.0.7's default gemset still ships the benchmark library even though it's no longer auto-required, so the unmodified scripts ran without changes).
puma_rss_after_load_mb is RSS (ps aux, RSS column) of the single Puma worker process immediately after both ab runs completed.
